context:
Goal: no stray branches on origin, and no lost work.
Problem (cannot undo): a test-author of lane comment-check-scans-shell pushed agent branches shell-tests (cc60ef375) and shell-tests-2 (71262843d) to origin unasked. They are unmerged, so deleting them needs your word. Both are copied to archive/shell-tests and archive/shell-tests-2 on origin; triage read origin at 03:08 CST and each copy points at the same commit. The cloud refused the delete ("unexpected disconnect while reading sideband packet").
Based on (ruling): .claude/CLAUDE.md Standing grants (owner, 2026-10-30 16:20 CDT): a session on your computer may delete merged branches only. Asked again because these two are unmerged.
Based on (read): rule shared-trees-archive-then-delete: once the archive push succeeds, nothing is lost.
Departs from: main — the 2 branches stay on origin → a session on your computer deletes shell-tests and shell-tests-2, and the archive copies stay.
Meanwhile: nothing waits on this. Step push-agent-branch-asks (#1833) makes such a push ask first.

options.label: Yes, delete the two branches
options.lose: Nothing: the archive copies hold both commits.

options.how: Both branches stay on origin next to their archive copies.
options.label: No, keep them

reply: Withdrawn by triage, 03:49 CST Nov 8: your standing grant already covers it. Main's .claude/CLAUDE.md Standing grants (changed by your item 219 a, Nov 4) lets a session on your computer delete a branch whose last commit is on an archive branch, when a coordinator asks. Both branches' last commits (cc60ef375, 71262843d) are on archive/shell-tests and archive/shell-tests-2 (read 03:48 CST). Triage had cited the older 'merged branches only' text. The coordinator routes the delete under the grant.
title: May a session on your computer delete the two stray agent branches shell-tests and shell-tests-2?
